title: Light editor theme uses lighter/darker colours incorrectly, modern style makes it worse
body: ### Tested versions 4.6 dev 3 ### System information Godot v4.6.dev3 - Fedora Linux 43.20250925.n.1 (Silverblue Prerelease) on Wayland - X11 display driver, Single-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - integrated AMD Radeon 780M Graphics (RADV PHOENIX) - AMD Ryzen 7 7840U w/ Radeon 780M Graphics (16 threads) - 30.64 GiB memory (please ignore that I'm using old prerelease version of my Linux distro at the time of writing, I was testing out other things as well and it does not impact this issue at all) ### Issue description Godot's light theme often uses incorrect colors, where highlighted/turned on things are darker, and content is shown on gray backgrounds. I think this should be regarded as a bug, as conventional design shows content on light backgrounds, and highlighted content is _usually_ shown as lighter or with an accent colour (or at least much lighter gray than Godot currently uses). Content on darker background might also introduce unneeded contrast/accessibility issues. #### Examples of other software UI Github. Current tab is lighter than inactive. Content is shown on light background. Godot website. Highlighted feature is shown as lighter. Same behavior with buttons, only links on the bottom on the page turn to accent colour instead. Firefox, Wikipedia. Current Firefox tab is shown as lighter than inactive. Wikipedia content is show on light background. Both Wikipedia and Firefox drop-downs have light background. Selected drop-down item is highlighted with accent colour. #### Godot UI I highlighted some specific parts where Godot uses colours wrongly in the light theme in the modern style: Even though classic style is still subpar, it has less issues than the modern style: Also I think it is noteworthy that dark style does not have these issues: I hope it’s clear that I took the time to write this issue not to criticize the project or the hard work of its contributors, but to help Godot continue improving and becoming even better. I guess I'll repeat myself here but I really think this should be regarded as a bug and not just a different opinion on aesthetics. ### Steps to reproduce - ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) -
